newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico primary Bondes rates fall at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico primary Bondes rates fall at auction.

text.p: The rate on Mexican government 728-day development bonds, or Bondes, fell 0.02 percentage points to 1.41 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate in Tuesday's primary auction, dealers said.
The 728-day Bondes were assigned at 97.76314 pesos.
Demand for the two-year Bondes was 2.49 billion pesos, compared with the 500 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
The rate on the 364-day Bondes fell 0.11 percentage points to 1.14 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate.
The one-year Bondes were assigned at 98.98065 pesos, the central bank said.
Demand for the one-year Bondes was 2.30 billion pesos, compared to the 500 million on offer by Banco de Mexico.
